summary_claims.claim: Created on 31 January 2025 ahead of the Paris summit, steered by SGDSN and DGE (SGDSN mission page). Literal: 'On 31 January 2025, ahead of the French summit for action on AI, the national institute for the evaluation and security of AI was created'.
Roadmap project 5 targets systemic risks from large-scale information manipulation, offensive cyber and CBRN proliferation; project 6 evaluates agent systems.

note: Official SGDSN page, roadmap PDF (French and the SGDSN English courtesy translation) and press release n. 373 of 12 Feb 2026 confirm the content. There is no founding decree; creation date and steering rest on the SGDSN page, which is an official source. english_version 'government translation' by SGDSN is right (SGDSN publishes it and it is a stored source). No newer version found.
